notes.note: Sannr client limitation (@sannr/sannr 0.1.0-alpha.10), reported in CodeTV preparation October 7–9, 2026; not a provider defect or a new execution: A multi-request capture echoed the Account SID in the returned captures object. Keep batch output private and redact identifiers before sharing a transcript; a captured value is not automatically safe for publication. Source: BUGS.md / CAPTURE-001; this package retains the authored summary, not private raw evidence.

Sannr client limitation (@sannr/sannr 0.1.0-alpha.10), reported in CodeTV preparation October 7–9, 2026; not a provider defect or a new execution: A passing api_request assertion did not update the legacy verified-operation counter. Inspect the scoped execution receipt and its assertions rather than interpreting a zero counter as proof no request passed. Shared authored notes are still not execution verification. Source: BUGS.md / VERIFY-001; this package retains the authored summary, not private raw evidence.

Sannr client limitation (@sannr/sannr 0.1.0-alpha.10), reported in CodeTV preparation October 7–9, 2026; not a provider defect or a new execution: The earlier default map command sent unrequested probes and tested paths from other stacks against the wrong Twilio host. Do not use it as a no-traffic setup check. Retrieve the selected stack locally; when a request is authorized, use this operation with its own stack/host. Source: BUGS.md / MAP-001; this package retains the authored summary, not private raw evidence.
